gaps.what: States on the brief's scope not reached: the Trucial emirates one by one (Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras al-Khaimah, Umm al-Quwain), the Sultanate of Lahej, the Kathiri sultanate of Seiyun, the Federation and Protectorate of South Arabia, the Syrian opposition (2012-2024) and the Salvation Government, the Emirate of Riyadh, the Sheikhdom of Bushehr.
gaps.why: not reached: context/budget after thirteen dossiers (the brief asks for 6-10 first)

gaps.what: Provinces outside Iraq and Syria (Libya, Sinai, Khorasan and others) are not drawn; the Syrian side of the caliphate is dated mostly by confidence 1-2 events.
gaps.why: out of scope of the group; the Syrian war pages were thin

gaps.what: The 1798-1811 phase (Murad Bey in Upper Egypt, the beys' return, the 1811 massacre, the flight to Nubia) is not covered.
The Taiz, Hodeidah and west-coast fronts, Dhamar, Ibb and Amran are not dated by any page opened; the Mokha district is subtracted from 2015 and added in September 2026 by the page's own wording.
gaps.why: the Yemeni civil war page and the other four pages are silent on dates; Marib campaign article did not load

gaps.what: Areas A and B are drawn as eight city discs of 9 km; the Oslo II page names no cities or redeployment dates; the Hebron Protocol, Wye River memorandum and Areas A, B and C article were not opened.

Suzerain-side events (Ikhshidid 944-969, Sulayhid 1064-1067, Ayyubid 1174-1238, Rasulid 1238) are recorded in the suzerains' dossiers, not here; the Hejaz extent before 1800 is the 19th-century limits.
gaps.why: the Sharifate page gives no earlier extent and no dates for them

problems: french-mandate-for-syria-and-lebanon has a 1923-03 loss whose counterpart is the string 'Mandatory Palestine'; it should read british-mandate-for-palestine.

republic-of-iraq's 2005 'gain' of the Kurdistan Region would absorb the Region into Iraq on the map from 2005 to 2014; kurdistan-region treats it as a separate autonomous state throughout (2005 is a rename). Reconcile (vassal_start or drop the gain).

AANES ends in 2026 and the Houthis are drawn to 2026: both go past the Cliopatria 2024 horizon (the year dock runs to 2026, per the schema 'for a state alive today, the current year'; today is 2026-10-25).

emirate-of-diriyah uses the string 'Bani Khalid Emirate' as counterpart; it should read emirate-of-bani-khalid. Its 1794 Qatif / 1795 Hasa dates and the Saud page's 1789 / 1792 differ from the Bani Khalid page's 1793 used here.

sharifate-of-mecca overlaps the Hejaz as drawn by ottoman-empire (1517-12 gain), emirate-of-diriyah (1802-1812) and muhammad-ali-dynasty (to 1840); the reviewer should decide whether the sharifate is a vassal tint or caption only. Ayyubid, Ikhshidid, Rasulid and Sulayhid vassal events already name this slug.

republic-of-yemen's contest_start with houthis (2014-09) draws all of former North Yemen except Ma'rib as contested from 2014; the houthis keyframes show the same land as held, so the renderer should treat the contest as the blend and not draw both fully.

palestinian-national-authority: the Gaza Strip is drawn whole from 1994 (the page's 60%-to-100% share of Gaza after 2005 cannot be mapped) and the 2005 gain repeats it; gaza-hamas names the PNA as predecessor, matching the 2007 loss.

southern-transitional-council held ground for eight years (2018-2026), under the brief's ten-year rule; written because republic-of-yemen names it and the scope lists the post-2011 wars as contested zones.
